statement: A v2 completion without environment, with a malformed observed_at, with a missing member, or with a fifth member, is each refused at append, observed; one with the four named members and explicit unknowns is accepted; a v1 completion without environment is still accepted; the mutation removing each rule is observed accepting what it should refuse

Two v2 observations for one criterion under one handoff with opposite statuses and different environments are both accepted and the report derives contested; a later pass in one environment leaves it contested; a pass in both clears it; an owner re-statement of the criterion naming the assumed environment clears it; the same criterion id under two handoffs is not contested; a thread with no results still reports cannot-tell and never contested; the mutation removing the handoff key is observed conflating them

A correction of another actor's event, of an unknown target, and of a correction are each refused; the author's own succeeds with in_reply_to null and the one-root rule still holds; observed through append and verifyLog; each rule's mutation observed
A v2 event retried with the same id and canonical intent returns reused; the same id with a different corrects, or a different schema_version, collides; observed through appendEvent

After an author corrects its addressed review, the recipient's inbox still lists the review and the recipient's reply is still accepted, in strict_relay, free_form and coordinator_led, observed through inbox and append
The report lists a correction beside its original with the original's status unchanged, observed through the report's output; a mutation that replaces the original is observed and killed
A real v2 event validates against event-v2.schema.json and the verifier; the one-definition control covers the v2 vocabulary, observed by mutation
executed= from the run over every mutation named above; proof, completion, withdrawal, bctx, report and sdk suites pass; the historical log verifies unchanged
